patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image/video that spans the entire viewport width, setting an immersive initial experience.
Alternating background colors define distinct content sections, creating strong visual breaks and clear content segmentation.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif headings are used for key messages and section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impact.
The initial hero image/video uses a subtle parallax or pan effect, where the background content moves slower than the foreground text as the user scrolls, creating depth.
A prominent, oversized brand name is used as a final, impactful statement before the footer, acting as a concluding brand anchor.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video or large image that uses a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the background content moves at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth.
The primary navigation elements (logo, mission, careers links) remain fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access.
Content sections are visually separated by distinct, full-width background color blocks that change abruptly as the user scrolls, clearly delineating different topics.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (~4-5x body) with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp corners dominate.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, oversized typography, particularly the 'American Housing' brand name at the bottom, which acts as a powerful visual anchor. This, combined with the impactful, full-bleed hero video/image and the strong, contrasting color blocking, creates a memorable and authoritative presence that feels more like an editorial piece than a typical corporate site.
